item.summary: fix(cron): required delivery failures no longer report success (#126164) * fix(cron): preserve required delivery completion Record durable completion independently from payload execution so required delivery failure cannot delete one-shots or report successful waits.\n\nCloses #126163 * fix(cron): keep completion contracts acyclic * fix(cron): keep delivery predicate private
